[[Haioss' Blessing]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[Scythe]] dropped by [[Haioss, Blessed Wind]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Fahranur, The First City]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing Damage]]: 9-29 (Requires 6 [[Scythe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while Health is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] 20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30
:Two-handed

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Suntouched Scythe]], [[dye]]d silver.
